versions.changelog:
- Initial release of market-pulse-bundle: combines price tick, Fear & Greed index, and regime analysis in a single real-time call.
- Streamlines access to core market signals from live trading data, not backtests or aggregators.
- Simple GET endpoint with x402 payment—no API key or account setup needed, just EVM wallet with USDC.
- Includes adaptive pricing tiers with automatic early adopter discounts.
- Example usage and response provided for quick integration.
